Research / public notebook

A theory that has
to survive contact.

Restless separates enduring product decisions from provisional beliefs, open hypotheses and implementation defects. Experiments are allowed to change the organisation.

Accepted direction

Enduring

  • Deterministic rules own authority and consequential effects.
  • Files are the primary work primitive.
  • Every executable outcome has an accountable lead and real Staff production.
  • Review arrives in the outcome’s native form.
Supported, not universal

Provisional

  • One end-to-end worker is the best default inside a coherent outcome.
  • Parallel capacity pays when work arrives as independent, locally closing units.
  • Natural supervision over sparse facts beats forced coordination ritual.
Still to learn

Open

  • What signal predicts context saturation?
  • When does a parallel hand become Staff?
  • Which artifact boundaries generalise beyond code?
  • Can inbound signals preserve authority and owner attention?

Method

Observation before fact.

Claim

Someone or something asserts it.

Observation

A method records what happened.

Evidence

Material supports or challenges it.

Accepted fact

The company decides what to act on.

Controlled dogfood can test a mechanism. It cannot establish customer demand, broad reliability or real-world commercial performance.

Useful questions remain open.

That is the point of publishing the notebook rather than manufacturing certainty.
